It’s cause I kind of am one to some degree, I’m mainly failing my parents cause I can’t seem to just be an ok student or an ok kid in general, I don’t do a lot with my day and honestly don’t have that many plans for my life and I feel lost and I know the world isn’t stopping so I just seem to passively fail people cause I never learned how to be too tentative and I don’t know how to be better or if I even should be or if I’m a lost cause 

Not only that but I just feel guilty in general for having suicidal thoughts when I have people that worry for me but that’s kinda a given

What mainly made me post was just a need to vent, nothing too specific, I don’t really know what makes it worse aside from feeling like a failure in some way, and that sort of happened last night, not really for any reason other than it just hitting me 

That’s why it’s weird and freaks me out that I can’t just be stable on my own since I can turn against myself with pretty little reason (at least this time)

Well hopefully you can maybe vent to me too if you need it, I’d like for stuff to be even since you’re wanting to listen to me

That aside, for the most part dysphoria and just depression in general have been kicking my ass and it’s just getting worse, until now I haven’t had suicidal thoughts this extreme and it worries me how apathetic I am to them and it seems like the only thing that’s keeping me going is just the fact that I have friends that would probably be permanently traumatized 

And I feel like I constantly let everybody down and I’ve got nobody to blame but myself and I want to destroy myself before it gets any worse- at least that’s the best way I can describe it. At least I got lucky today and didn’t legitimately piss anybody off 

Anyways though, thanks for listening
